authority: Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CNIL) — France's data protection supervisory authority. Under Art. 53(2) of Regulation (EU) 2017/2226 it must, upon request, assist and advise you in exercising your EES rectification rights. (France's designated EES controller contact is pending verification — see UNVERIFIED/TODO.md.)
contactChannel: Online contact and complaint forms on the CNIL website; postal contact published there.
expectedTimeline: Reply within 45 days of receipt of an Article 52 request (Regulation (EU) 2017/2226, Art. 52(1)).
appealPath: Action or complaint before the competent authorities or courts (Art. 54), including when the 45-day deadline passes unanswered; the supervisory authority's assistance remains available throughout (Art. 54(2)).
languageRequirements: Not verified per country — the authority's site states accepted languages; we provide the template in French and English.
